title: 采购承诺、收货、开票及付款敞口
context: 采购＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 截至2025年底每供应商，采购订单金额、实际合格收货计价、发票金额、实付及未付余额；两套数据分别按供应商汇总，保留无采购供应商。
commonError: 采购行和发票行直接连接会重复计入付款。
executionSteps: 聚合采购行和发票余额
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,s.supplier_id
